verdict.rationale: SAM.gov publishes documented public REST APIs on open.gsa.gov covering Entity Management, Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy and Assistance Listings. The docs include parameters, JSON/CSV output, API keys and a downloadable OpenAPI spec. However, the evidence shows only read/search (GET) access, not driving the product's actions such as registration or workflows. Access also requires account-tied API keys, approved System Accounts for higher tiers, and a 1,000,000-record cap. Missing for 10: documented write or action endpoints for driving the product rather than just querying it, keyless or low-friction agent access, an OpenAPI spec at a standard discoverable path (probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Users can make GET calls using any Browser or a Restful API client such as Postman.
Get Opportunities API provides all the published opportunity details based on the request parameters. This API supports pagination as needed.
It returns data in the JSON or CSV format as selected by the user. It can return only the first 1,000,000 records.
registered users must obtain the API Key from the https://sam.gov/workspace/profile/account-details page using the field, “Public API Key”.
the Entity Management API documentation carries an OpenAPI Specification File section with the downloadable spec.
